title: Change file or directory owner
summary: Use chown to change the owner of a file or directory. This is often necessary when files are created by root but need to be accessed by a regular user.

steps.explain: Change the owner of a file or directory to a specific user. Requires root privileges.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The username of the new owner.

placeholders.name: PATH
placeholders.description: Path to the file or directory.

rollback.explain: Change ownership back to the original owner (often root).

placeholders.name: ORIGINAL_OWNER
placeholders.description: The original owner of the file (e.g., root).

placeholders.name: PATH
placeholders.description: Path to the file or directory.

warnings: chown clears setuid and setgid bits.
Non-root users cannot give away files they own to other users.
